fzf_default_opts.description: Default command-line options for fzf (equivalent to $FZF_DEFAULT_OPTS environment variable). Example: '--layout=reverse --border --cycle'.

shell_integration_bash.description: Enable Bash shell integration (key bindings and fuzzy completion).

shell_integration_zsh.description: Enable Zsh shell integration (key bindings and fuzzy completion).

shell_integration_fish.description: Enable Fish shell integration (key bindings and fuzzy completion).
